description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA). This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives, helping them regain independence and improve their quality of life through comprehensive occupational therapy services.

In this full-time role, you will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to implement individualized treatment plans, provide therapeutic interventions, and document patient progress. We are seeking a passionate and skilled COTA committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care in a supportive environment.

We offer a competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, commensurate with your experience and expertise. If you are ready to contribute your talents to a facility that values professional growth and exceptional patient outcomes, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) license in Florida.
Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation setting preferred.
Strong clinical skills and a commitment to patient-centered care.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Certified Dietary Manager for a premier skilled nursing facility in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL. This full-time role offers competitive compensation ranging from $60,000 to $70,000 annually, with consistent 8-hour shifts.

Join a welcoming environment in a 55-59 bed facility, currently serving a census of 43 residents. Located on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a pleasant neighborhood behind the building, the facility offers an excellent work-life balance, just 15 minutes from the beach. Enjoy the serene atmosphere with two courtyards available for residents and staff.

This is an urgent opportunity to lead our dietary services team, ensuring the highest standards of nutrition and food service for our residents. Your expertise will contribute significantly to the well-being and satisfaction of those in our care.
requirements: Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of food service regulations and sanitation standards
Proven ability to manage dietary staff and operations
